The `/desk-*` panes take the bubble gray as their background, and bubbles stay dark in a dark theme inside tmux.

- With an Omarchy theme, the `/desk-*` panes are filled with the same gray as your prompt bubbles, so a pane seated above the prompt reads as one box (uses Claude Code 2.1.311's pane `backgroundColor`). Without the theme they look as before
- Inside tmux, which draws 256 colors, the bubble gray is now the nearest gray of the 256-color palette. In a dark theme the bubbles, code blocks, edited-file rows and panes came out light gray (`#5f5f5f`) and dim text faded into them; they now stay dark (`#303030`), and the round bubble corners match

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
